meta.title: How it works: Agental Talents
meta.description: From creating your profile to receiving your fee: how Agental represents you and works for you, step by step.

hero.title: How Agental works, for artists
hero.subtitle: A real agent who represents you, an AI working for you continuously. Here's the journey, jargon-free.

sections.title: A profile that reflects you
sections.body: You fill in your stage identity, your physical profile, your media, your specialities and your availability. Every technical term is explained in plain language, so you do not need the trade's jargon to begin. A reel shot on a phone is enough to start.

sections.title: The contract that gets you represented
sections.body: The mandate is the contract every artist signs with their agent. It is governed by French law. It is free, carries no commitment on your side, and can be ended whenever you want. By signing it you authorise us to represent you, to look for roles for you and to negotiate your contracts.

sections.title: A watch that never stops
sections.body: Our system watches casting listings continuously, in France and internationally. It compares each listing with your profile and spots the ones that genuinely match: your age, your typology, your languages, your area, your availability. You receive targeted proposals without searching yourself.

sections.title: The studio that builds your confidence
sections.body: When a role asks for a self-tape, our studio works with you during the take. It guides you on framing, lighting and sound in real time. A vocal coach lets you hear the right intonation when the role calls for an accent. You record several versions, compare them, and send the best straight from the app.

sections.title: From selection to fee
sections.body: Once you are selected, we take over the contractual side. We negotiate your fee and your terms, we check that the contract is legal, and we follow the shoot. Agental collects your fee, withholds its commission, and pays your share within seven days of actual payment.

summary.title: In short
summary.body: The whole path at a glance: profile, mandate, AI watch, self-tape, contract. You keep control at every step, and a human always checks contracts before signature.

hero.title: Artists' frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you want to know before getting started. Another question? Write to us.

items.a: A platform for performers, in beta. You build your profile, keep your headshots, credits, reel and self-tapes in one place, and prepare your casting materials. Application drafts always wait for your review.
Not during the beta. Agental does not act as your agent and takes no commission. If representation opens later, it will come with its own written agreement that you choose to accept.

items.q: How much does it cost to start?
items.a: Nothing. The Basic plan covers your profile and media. Paid plans and Limelight websites are optional and never a condition for auditions or applications.

items.q: Do I need experience to sign up?
items.a: No. Agental is precisely for the profiles underserved by traditional agencies. A reel filmed on your phone is enough to start.
It's the standard contract between an artist and their agent, governed by French law. It authorises us to represent you and negotiate for you. Free, no commitment on your side.

items.q: How much commission does Agental take?
items.a: 10% on Basic and Pro, 7.5% on Premium, 6% on Ultimate. The more you rise, the more you keep.

items.q: Is the commission on top of the subscription?
items.a: The mandate (free) and its possible commission are separate from the subscription (optional). The subscription funds tech services; it never buys access to opportunities.
Yes, with a short notice and without having to justify it. You stay free.

items.q: How does the AI find roles for me?
items.a: It cross-references your profile (physique, specialties, languages, accents, availability) with open castings and suggests the ones that truly match.

items.q: Do I keep control of my applications?
items.a: Yes. You set your preferences, project types, mobility, minimum fee, and nothing is committed in your name without your agreement. You decide, always.

items.q: Does the subscription give me privileged access to castings?
items.a: No. Opportunities go through the mandate, which is free. The subscription lowers the commission and unlocks tools, never a fast pass.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying?
items.a: You automatically move back to the Basic plan. You remain represented.

items.q: Does it work on a basic phone?
items.a: Yes. The Self-tape Studio has a degraded mode designed for modest devices and slow connections.

meta.title: About us: Agental
meta.description: A group of young actors and builders, on campus, with roots in France and at USC: help every performer get a fair shot at a role.

hero.title: Who we are
hero.subtitle: Agental builds tools for performers and casting teams. Behind the technology there is a group of young actors and builders, and one conviction.

origin.title: Our story
origin.body: Agental was started by a group of young actors and builders who saw how unequal the road to a role can be. Representation tends to go to the few who already have connections, live in the right city or can afford an agent. We want every performer to get the same fair shot.
origin.body2: We started where we are: on campus, with roots in France and at USC. We are building from there, one performer at a time.

stance.title: Where we stand
stance.body: We believe an accent, an origin or a singular look are strengths, because productions are looking for real and varied personalities. We believe a good start should be open to everyone, and free. And we believe technology must stay in the service of people, with clarity: Agental uses AI to help performers prepare and to help casting teams find the right profiles faster, and every suggestion it makes can be explained. People make the decisions.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To help every performer be seen, and to make the search for talent fairer and more effective. On both sides, we want the right encounters to finally happen.

figuration.name: Background acting
figuration.tagline: The way into film and television. No experience required.
figuration.audience: You want to be on screen, see how a set works and build a first credit. Every profile, every age, anywhere in France.
figuration.chapo: Background work means appearing on screen in a film, a series, a commercial or a music video, with no lines to perform. A silhouette is a noticed piece of background work, where your face or a specific action stands out. These are often the first steps in the trade, and an excellent way to understand a set.
figuration.apporte: We represent you with a real mandate, free of charge. Our AI spots the background castings that match your profile and your area, and alerts you as soon as an urgent role comes up. When a self-tape is asked for, we coach you so that it is clean and sets you apart. Your visibility grows, and you can move on to silhouette roles and then small speaking parts.
steps: Create your profile and add a few photos.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive your first targeted background castings.

faq.q: Do you need experience to do background work?
faq.a: No. Background work is open to beginners. It is often the first step of a career.

faq.q: Do you have to live in the capital?
faq.a: No. Shoots happen all over the country. You state your mobility, and we propose roles you can reach from home.

faq.q: Is background work paid?
faq.a: Yes. A background fee usually sits between 80 and 180 euros a day.

faq.q: How do you move from background work to small roles?
faq.a: By building your profile and your self-tapes. We coach you to move towards roles with lines.

silhouette.name: Walk-on
silhouette.tagline: A step up from background: one gesture, one presence that registers.
silhouette.audience: You have a look, a bearing or a precise action to play on camera. A silent but visible role, usually better paid than background work.
silhouette.chapo: A silhouette is a noticed piece of background work: your face is distinguishable, or you carry out a specific action on screen. It is the step just above background work, often better paid, and the most natural way through to roles with lines.
silhouette.apporte: We target the silhouette roles that match your typology and your area, and we alert you fast because they often go out at short notice. We coach you on the self-tape when one is asked for, and we put forward what makes you recognisable on screen. We negotiate your fee and check your image rights.
steps: Create your profile and take care over your front and profile photos.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive silhouette roles targeted on your area.

faq.q: How does it differ from background work?
faq.a: In background work you populate the scene without being identifiable. In a silhouette, your face or your action is distinguished on screen.

faq.q: Is a silhouette better paid?
faq.a: Often yes. The fee generally exceeds a background one, and a particular constraint can raise it further.

faq.q: Do you need experience?
faq.a: No, but a first background experience helps you feel at ease on set.

seconds-roles.name: Supporting roles
seconds-roles.tagline: Lines, a character, series and feature films.
seconds-roles.audience: You act, you have (or are building) some experience, and you want speaking parts in series, drama and film.
seconds-roles.chapo: A small or supporting role is a character with lines, present in one or several scenes, without being the lead. These roles are the heart of casting volume, and a solid path to building an acting career.
seconds-roles.apporte: We represent you and target the small-role castings made for your profile. Our AI compares each listing with your age, your typology, your accents and your languages. We coach you on your self-tapes so your application lands as close as possible to what the role expects, and we put forward what sets you apart. We negotiate your contract and secure your fee.
steps: Create a complete profile, with a reel if you have one.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive targeted small-role castings and shoot your coached self-tapes.

faq.q: What is the difference between a small role and background work?
faq.a: A small role has lines to perform. Background work appears on screen without lines.

faq.q: Do you need acting training?
faq.a: Useful, but not required. Many performers progress through practice and good self-tape coaching.

faq.q: What does a small role in a series pay?
faq.a: Often between 350 and 800 euros a day, depending on the project.

publicite.name: Commercials
publicite.tagline: The best-paid shoots, open to every profile.
publicite.audience: A face, a family, an athlete, a senior, a child, expert hands… Advertising looks for real people, not models. High fees and negotiated image rights.
publicite.chapo: Commercial casting recruits faces and silhouettes for brand campaigns, on television, online or in print. It is one of the best-paid segments of the trade, and it looks for a wide variety of profiles, from couples to families, from athletes to distinctive faces.
publicite.apporte: We target the commercial castings suited to your profile and alert you quickly, because these castings often move fast. We coach you on your self-tape so it is clean and convincing. We check image rights, a key point in advertising, and we negotiate your fee and the broadcast terms.
steps: Create your profile and take care over your photos.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive targeted, fast-moving commercial castings.

faq.q: Are commercial castings well paid?
faq.a: Yes. A commercial fee often sits between 800 and 3,000 euros a day, excluding broadcast rights.

faq.q: What are image rights in advertising?
faq.a: The agreement to use your image for the campaign's broadcast. We check and negotiate those rights for you.

faq.q: Do you need experience?
faq.a: No. Advertising looks above all for credible and varied profiles.

photo.name: Photo
photo.tagline: Campaigns, catalogues, editorial: your image, put to work.
photo.audience: You are at ease in front of the lens for commercial or editorial shoots. Authentic faces, every type and every age.
photo.chapo: Photo casting recruits models and faces for advertising shoots, brand campaigns, catalogues and editorials. It addresses a wide variety of profiles, well beyond the standards of classic modelling.
photo.apporte: We spot the photo castings that match you, we handle your image rights, and we negotiate your terms. We advise you on your profile visuals so they serve you best. Your singular look is an asset, and we put it forward.
steps: Create your profile with varied photos.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive targeted photo and fashion castings.

faq.q: Do you need to be a professional model?
faq.a: No. Photography and fashion increasingly look for varied and authentic profiles.

faq.q: Who handles my image rights?
faq.a: Agental checks and negotiates your image rights for each project.

faq.q: Which photos should go in my profile?
faq.a: Sharp, varied photos. We advise you on what shows you best.

voix-doublage.name: Voice & dubbing
voix-doublage.tagline: Your voice is enough: ads, dubbing, narration, e-learning.
voix-doublage.audience: You have a voice that carries, an accent, a language or a particular timbre. The work happens in a studio, often without travelling far.
voix-doublage.chapo: Voice casting recruits performers and voices for dubbing, radio advertising, e-learning, audiobooks and synthetic voices. It is a trade in its own right, which values timbre, diction and the ability to act with the voice alone.
voix-doublage.apporte: We target the voice castings suited to your timbre and your languages. Our vocal coach helps you prepare your auditions and adjust your interpretation, including for requested accents. We negotiate your sessions and secure your rights.
steps: Create your profile and record a voice sample.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive targeted voice and dubbing castings.

faq.q: Do you need a studio to start?
faq.a: No. A clean recording with headphones and a microphone is enough for your first auditions.

faq.q: What does a voice session pay?
faq.a: Often between 200 and 800 euros, depending on the project and the rights.

faq.q: Are accents a plus?
faq.a: Yes. Accents and languages clearly widen your opportunities.

enfants.name: Children & teens
enfants.tagline: A strict protective framework, so they can act safely.
enfants.audience: Your child wants to be on set? Background, commercials, series: the opportunities exist, inside a protective legal framework we apply to the letter.
enfants.chapo: Children's casting recruits young people under 16 for cinema, series, fashion and advertising. In France this field is strictly governed by law to protect the child. Agental applies every one of those protections and supports parents at each step.
enfants.apporte: We spot the castings suited to your child, we assemble the regulatory files, and we make sure every protection is respected. You keep control and visibility over everything.
steps: Create your child's profile with your parental consent.
Sign the mandate, free of charge.
Receive supervised and tracked castings.

faq.q: Is it legal to have my child perform?
faq.a: Yes, within a strict framework. An authorisation from the departmental commission is mandatory, and Agental handles the file.

faq.q: What happens to the money my child earns?
faq.a: 90% of the fee is deposited in a blocked account at the Caisse des dépôts until majority.

faq.q: Do I have to be present?
faq.a: Yes. Parental presence is mandatory at casting and on set.

faq.q: Can my child shoot at night?
faq.a: Night shoots are forbidden for under-16s, except under a tightly governed exemption.

createurs.name: Content creators
createurs.tagline: Your audience and your ease on camera are casting assets.
createurs.audience: You already create content and want to monetise your presence: placements, brand campaigns, hybrid formats. We structure and negotiate for you.
createurs.chapo: Content-creator casting connects creators active on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Twitch with brands and productions. Advertisers look for authentic creators to carry their campaigns, and this market is growing fast.
createurs.apporte: We represent you and target the collaboration opportunities suited to your editorial line and your audience. We negotiate your terms, we check the contracts, and we help you professionalise your activity while keeping your creative freedom.
steps: Create your profile and connect your channels.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive targeted collaboration proposals.

faq.q: Is there a minimum follower count?
faq.a: No. Your niche and your authenticity count as much as the size of your audience.

faq.q: Does Agental take a commission on my collaborations?
faq.a: On contracts landed through Agental, yes, according to your plan's decreasing commission. Your personal activity stays yours.

faq.q: Do I keep my creative freedom?
faq.a: Yes. We defend your interests, you keep the hand on your content.

performeurs.name: Performers & stage
performeurs.h1: Casting for performers and stage artists
performeurs.tagline: Dance, music, magic, circus, hosting, stunt work: your discipline is a role.
performeurs.audience: For every stage artist who wants access to more opportunities and representation by an agent. Your discipline, your level and your versatility are your assets.
performeurs.chapo: Performer casting recruits stage artists for events, shows, music videos, shoots and hosting. It covers a wide diversity of disciplines: dance, music, magic, circus, hosting, stunt work and many more.
performeurs.apporte: We target the castings suited to your discipline and your area, we negotiate your terms, and we secure your contracts. We put your specific skills forward with productions and events.
steps: Create your profile and present your discipline and your videos.
Sign your free mandate.
Receive castings suited to your art.

faq.q: Which disciplines are covered?
faq.a: Dance, music, magic, circus, hosting, stunt work, and many other stage practices.

faq.q: Can I list several disciplines?
faq.a: Yes. Your versatility widens your opportunities.

faq.q: Do you need a professional level?
faq.a: Your actual level is valued as it is. We target the opportunities that suit it.

items.q: Who owns my site and photos?
items.a: You do. Your photos, your words and your domain belong to you.

items.q: Do I need to be an Agental member?
items.a: Limelight is open to every performer. Buying a site is optional, and it has no effect on joining Agental or being presented to casting.
We crop, resize and compress your photos so they load fast. Faces stay exactly as they are, because casting needs to recognize you in the room.
It depends on what you send us. We confirm the timing when you start, and you see a private preview before anything goes live.

items.q: What happens after the first year?
items.a: Hosting renews at $49 a year for Essential and $79 a year for Signature. You can cancel from your dashboard before it renews.

items.q: I'm a musician, dancer or voice actor. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. Templates start with actors and include sections for audio demos, tracks, choreography and voice work. Tell us what you do and we'll fit the site to it.
